concept: AWS Config: continuous configuration evaluation (public S3 buckets)
tests: Choosing a managed service that continuously evaluates resource configuration and alerts when a bucket becomes public.
expected: AWS Config with the managed rule s3-bucket-public-read-prohibited — continuous evaluation, notifications and auto-remediation (SSM). Triggers: "continuously evaluates configuration", "detect and alert when changed", "public access".
why_not: Inspector — workload vulnerabilities; Macie — finding sensitive data; Trusted Advisor — periodic checks without continuous evaluation or remediation.
